# wesleymatosdev/skills

> Personal agent-skill catalog. Authored and curated by Wesley Matos.

Install any skill via the Skills CLI:
  npx skills add wesleymatosdev/skills --skill <name> -y

## Categories
- 🧭 **Agent Workflow** (`workflow/`) — Skills for agent self-improvement loops: routing learnings, compacting context, closing the memory gap between sessions.
- 📐 **Engineering Standards** (`standards/`) — Verification gates, evidence hierarchies, taste-tested quality standards for engineering work.

## Skills
- [`learning-routing`](https://skills.wesleymatos.dev/workflow/learning-routing/SKILL.md) (workflow, v0.1.0, MIT): Classify learnings into memory, skills, or project records.
- [`ce-pickup`](https://skills.wesleymatos.dev/workflow/ce-pickup/SKILL.md) (workflow, v0.1.0, MIT): Extract ce-handoff/v1 documents from past Hermes sessions with a local Ollama model, then resume work without paying frontier-model context costs.
- [`proof-bearing-verification`](https://skills.wesleymatos.dev/standards/proof-bearing-verification/SKILL.md) (standards, v0.1.0, MIT): Prove behavior before declaring engineering work complete.
